core_rule: Gold window equals convergence, hush, softening, and open body language. It is not yellow lamp.
hierarchy: Primary cue: temporal rhythm tied to pulse cadence.
Secondary cue: material change from ash to gold alignment.
Tertiary cue: UI reticle mirrors world state and never explains information absent from world object.

READING.light: Low amber/copper edge glints, long soft shadows.
READING.vfx: Ash motes orbit slowly with breath-like expansion.
READING.animation: Relic core breathes; player/device steadies and tracks pulse.
READING.audio: Low sub pulse, granular ash hiss, two-beat loop.
READING.material: Matte ash with faint vein flicker under surface.
READING.ui: Reticle iris narrows/opens with pulse, no text.
READING.environment: Dust floats upward, cables/ash lean toward source.

SAFE_WINDOW.light: Thin gold rim traces interactable edges; shadow pauses; bloom only on silhouettes.
SAFE_WINDOW.vfx: Motes snap inward into clean ring or spiral; sparks rise vertically.
SAFE_WINDOW.animation: Target opens and exposes core; shutters align; anticipation frame.
SAFE_WINDOW.audio: One-frame silence then soft chime and warm transient.
SAFE_WINDOW.material: Veins become molten; cracks align; surface smooths.
SAFE_WINDOW.ui: Reticle becomes complete ring; optional icon-only hint glows.
SAFE_WINDOW.environment: Wind stops, particles suspend, nearby cloth/cables relax.

HOSTILE.player_meaning: Danger. Timing missed or threat active.
HOSTILE.light: Hard angled slashes; contrast spikes. Red can support but not carry meaning.
HOSTILE.vfx: Ash ejects outward; motes become jagged trails.
HOSTILE.audio: Pulse doubles, dissonant scrape, low growl layer.
HOSTILE.material: Surface chars, veins stutter, edges sharpen.
HOSTILE.environment: Wind gusts outward, dust falls, bells/cables snap.

SUCCESS.light: Warm traveling highlight moves from action point into world path.
SUCCESS.vfx: Ring resolves into upward plume; sparks spiral cleanly.
SUCCESS.audio: Clear consonant chord; pulse resolves downward.
SUCCESS.material: Gold fades into stable white-amber seam.
SUCCESS.environment: Furnace channel ignites; fog/ash opens next route.

FAILURE.light: Gold collapses into dull ember; brief desaturation.
FAILURE.vfx: Motes drop like ash rain; ring buckles.
FAILURE.audio: Muted thud plus swallowed chime; pulse restarts slower once.
FAILURE.material: Veins crust over; crack network misaligns.
FAILURE.ui: Reticle dims then rebuilds from first pulse.
FAILURE.environment: Wind dies; dust settles; object returns to Reading.

quality_gates: SUCCESS feedback starts within 100 ms of valid input.
Failure reset teaches next attempt; no full-state ambiguity longer than 500 ms.
At least three channels change per state across motion, material, audio, environment, UI.
Gold never used for non-actionable decoration within Ashwake encounters.
Reticle never introduces information missing from world object.
Blind playtest pass requires 75%+ correct state naming from no-text clips.
blind_playtest_observables: 80% of first-time players describe SAFE_WINDOW as when it opens, forms ring, gets quiet, or aligns, not when text says.
70% act closer to pulse peak by third attempt.
Players can identify READING vs SAFE_WINDOW vs HOSTILE from muted video at 5 seconds.
Players can identify SAFE_WINDOW vs FAILURE from audio-only clip.
Mis-timed players say too early or too late without prompting.
